movies.title: Inception
movies.description: A skilled thief who steals corporate secrets through dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a C.E.O., but his tragic past may doom the project and his team to disaster.

movies.title: The Dark Knight
movies.description: When the menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman must accept one of the greatest psychological and physical tests of his ability to fight injustice.

movies.title: Interstellar
movies.description: When Earth becomes uninhabitable in the future, a farmer and ex-NASA pilot is tasked with piloting a spacecraft along with a team of researchers to find a new planet for humans.

movies.title: The Shawshank Redemption
movies.description: Over the course of several years, two convicts form a friendship, seeking consolation and eventual redemption through basic compassion.

movies.title: Pulp Fiction
movies.description: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster and his wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.

movies.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
movies.description: A writer encounters the owner of an aging high-class hotel, who tells him of his early years serving as a lobby boy in the hotel's glory years under an exceptional concierge.

movies.title: Parasite
movies.description: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

movies.title: Dune
movies.description: A noble family becomes embroiled in a war for control over the galaxy's most valuable asset while its heir becomes troubled by visions of a dark future.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
movies.description: Miles Morales catapults across the Multiverse, where he encounters a team of Spider-People charged with protecting its very existence.

movies.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
movies.description: A middle-aged Chinese immigrant is swept up into an insane adventure in which she alone can save existence by exploring other universes.

movies.title: Oppenheimer
movies.description: The story of American scientist J. Robert Oppenheimer and his role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II.

movies.title: The Batman
movies.description: When a sadistic serial killer begins murdering key political figures in Gotham, Batman is forced to investigate the city's hidden corruption and question his family's involvement.

movies.title: Whiplash
movies.description: A promising young drummer enrolls at a cut-throat music conservatory where his dreams of greatness are mentored by an instructor who will stop at nothing to realize a student's potential.

movies.title: John Wick
movies.description: An ex-hit-man comes out of retirement to track down the gangsters that took everything from him, with New York City as his bullet-riddled playground.

movies.title: Get Out
movies.description: A young African-American visits his white girlfriend's parents for the weekend, where his simmering uneasiness about their reception of him eventually reaches a boiling point.

movies.title: Dune: Part Two
movies.description: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family.

movies.title: RRR
movies.description: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, who once shared an unbreakable bond of brotherhood, decide to join forces and wage a heroic battle against oppressive colonial rulers in 1920s India.

movies.title: Baahubali 2: The Conclusion
movies.description: When Shiva, the son of Bahubali, learns about his royal heritage, he embarks on an epic quest to find answers and bring justice to the kingdom of Mahishmati while confronting the ruthless Bhallaladeva.

movies.title: Baahubali: The Beginning
movies.description: In the ancient kingdom of Mahishmati, an adventurous young man is drawn into an ancient dispute that reveals his royal bloodline and destiny to liberate his people.

movies.title: Kalki 2898 AD
movies.description: Set in a dystopian post-apocalyptic future in the city of Kasi, a modern-day avatar of Vishnu descends to protect the world from evil forces led by Supreme Yaskin.

movies.title: Pushpa: The Rise
movies.description: A laborer named Pushpa Raj rises through the ranks of a red sandalwood smuggling syndicate in the Seshachalam forests, defying law enforcement and rival cartels.

movies.title: Pushpa 2: The Rule
movies.description: Pushpa Raj expands his sandalwood empire onto a global scale while locked in a fierce, high-stakes psychological and violent duel with SP Bhanwar Singh Shekhawat.

movies.title: Salaar: Part 1 – Ceasefire
movies.description: In the dystopian city-state of Khansaar, a prince turns to his estranged, exiled childhood friend Deva to claim the throne and quell a brewing revolution.

movies.title: Devara: Part 1
movies.description: A fearless sea guardian battles ruthless smuggling clans across perilous waters to protect his coastal village and secure his family's enduring legacy.

movies.title: Rangasthalam
movies.description: Chitti Babu, a partially hearing-impaired engineer in 1980s rural Rangasthalam, takes on the ruthless village president to avenge his brother and liberate the village.

movies.title: Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo
movies.description: Bantu grows up under the harsh gaze of a critical father, only to discover he was switched at birth with the son of a billionaire and decides to protect his biological family.

movies.title: Magadheera
movies.description: A bike stuntman learns about his past incarnation as an elite warrior in 17th-century Rajasthan and fights to reunite with his reincarnated princess.

movies.title: Eega
movies.description: A murdered young man reincarnates as a housefly and embarks on a relentless, inventive revenge mission to protect his beloved and destroy his wealthy killer.

movies.title: Jersey
movies.description: A talented but failed cricketer in his late thirties decides to return to the sport despite health hazards to fulfill his young son's dream of getting an Indian jersey.

movies.title: Sita Ramam
movies.description: An orphaned soldier serving in Kashmir receives anonymous love letters from a woman named Sita, sparking an epic romance wrapped in patriotism and sacrifice.

movies.title: Hi Nanna
movies.description: A single father and celebrity photographer weaves imaginative stories about his daughter's missing mother until a compassionate stranger enters their lives.

movies.title: Hanu-Man
movies.description: In the fictional village of Anjanadri, a petty thief gains the supernatural powers of Lord Hanuman through an ancient gem and defends his village from a ruthless modern villain.

movies.title: Agent Sai Srinivasa Athreya
movies.description: A witty, quirky private detective based in Nellore takes on the suspicious case of an unidentified body found near railway tracks, uncovering a nationwide conspiracy.

movies.title: Mathu Vadalara
movies.description: A frustrated delivery boy desperate for fast money attempts a minor scam during a routine delivery, only to end up trapped in an apartment with a dead body.

movies.title: DJ Tillu
movies.description: A flamboyant local Hyderabadi disc jockey falls for a mysterious singer, only to find himself entangled in a murder mystery and extortion scheme.

movies.title: Saripodhaa Sanivaaram
movies.description: A man who channels all his pent-up fury only on Saturdays faces off against a corrupt, sadistic police inspector terrorizing the town of Sokulapalem.

movies.title: Mayabazar
movies.description: The timeless mythological comedy magnum opus following Lord Krishna, Balarama, and Ghatotkacha as they outwit Duryodhana to unite Sasirekha with Abhimanyu.

movies.title: Sankarabharanam
movies.description: The celebrated cultural masterpiece about an unyielding Carnatic classical music maestro and a dedicated courtesan's daughter who preserves his artistic tradition.

movies.title: Sagara Sangamam
movies.description: A brilliant classical dancer struggles with poverty, artistic rejection, and alcoholism while finding a quiet purpose in mentoring a young aspirant.

movies.title: Shiva
movies.description: A fresh college student in Hyderabad stands up against campus goons and political corruption, igniting a cinematic revolution in action storytelling.

movies.title: Athadu
movies.description: A professional hired gunman framed for an assassination assumes the identity of a deceased grandson in a warm rural joint family, protecting them from danger.

movies.title: Pokiri
movies.description: A ruthless mercenary working for the Hyderabad underworld hides a shocking secret identity while battling rival gangsters and corrupt police officers.

movies.title: Bommarillu
movies.description: A young man suffocated by his overbearing father's micromanagement finds courage to speak up after falling in love with a free-spirited woman.

movies.title: Nuvvu Naaku Nachav
movies.description: A witty, unemployed young man visits his father's friend's house in Hyderabad and unintentionally wins the heart of a bride-to-be, sparking hilarious family chaos.

movies.title: Vikram
movies.description: A covert commander leads a black-ops squad on the trail of a masked vigilante and a ruthless drug syndicate running a mega cartel.

movies.title: Kaithi
movies.description: A recently released prisoner seeking to meet his estranged daughter agrees to drive a truck full of unconscious poisoned police officers through a gauntlet of gangsters.

movies.title: Maharaja
movies.description: A quiet barber embarks on an unyielding quest to find his stolen dustbin 'Lakshmi', leading the police through a maze of unexpected secrets and dark justice.

movies.title: Soorarai Pottru
movies.description: Nedumaaran Rajangam sets out to make the common man fly and takes on the world's most capital-intensive industry with the help of his friends and family.

movies.title: 3 Idiots
movies.description: Two friends search for their long-lost college companion while reflecting on their hilarious and life-changing engineering student days.

movies.title: 12th Fail
movies.description: Based on the true story of Manoj Kumar Sharma, who overcomes extreme poverty, academic failure, and hardship to become an Indian Police Service officer.

movies.title: Andhadhun
movies.description: A seemingly blind pianist unintentionally becomes embroiled in the murder of a former film star after agreeing to perform a private concert in his home.

movies.title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
movies.description: Three childhood friends take an adventurous bachelor road trip across Spain, facing their deepest fears, past regrets, and discovering what truly matters.

movies.title: Manjummel Boys
movies.description: A group of close-knit friends from a small town in Kerala embark on a vacation to Kodaikanal, where one of them falls into the notoriously treacherous Guna Caves.

movies.title: Drishyam
movies.description: A devoted cable TV operator orchestrates an elaborate alibi to shield his family from prosecution after an accidental killing.

movies.title: Aavesham
movies.description: Three college students who arrive in Bangalore face brutal ragging from seniors and seek out a quirky local gangster named Ranga for protection.

movies.title: Kumbalangi Nights
movies.description: Four dysfunctional brothers living in a decaying home in Kumbalangi find solace and redemption through love, brotherhood, and compassion.

movies.title: Kantara
movies.description: A rebel hunter from a coastal Karnataka tribal community becomes chosen by the divine forest spirit Bhoota Kola to protect his sacred lands from a greedy feudal lord.

movies.title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
movies.description: Rocky, a fierce young assassin seeking to fulfill his dying mother's promise of absolute wealth and power, infiltrates the slave mines of Kolar Gold Fields.

movies.title: 777 Charlie
movies.description: Dharma, a reclusive and lonely factory worker leading a monotonous life, undergoes a life-altering transformation when an energetic Labrador pup wanders into his world.

reviews.comment: A masterpiece of modern cinema. The layered dream sequences are brilliantly executed and the emotional core hits hard.
Visually stunning with an intricate plot that rewards repeated viewings. Nolan at his finest.
Heath Ledger's Joker is the greatest villain performance ever captured on film. Absolutely electrifying.
The perfect superhero film. Dark, intense, and thought-provoking with incredible performances throughout.
An emotional journey through space and time. The docking scene had me on the edge of my seat.
A timeless story of hope and perseverance. Morgan Freeman's narration is perfection.
Tarantino's non-linear storytelling is genius. Every scene crackles with sharp dialogue.
A social commentary disguised as a thriller. Every twist is earned and devastating.
Visually breathtaking with incredible world-building. Villeneuve creates an immersive experience.
The animation is groundbreaking. Every frame is a work of art with an amazing soundtrack.
One of the most creative and heartfelt films ever made. Michelle Yeoh is extraordinary.
A haunting portrait of genius and guilt. Cillian Murphy delivers a career-defining performance.
Intense and gripping from start to finish. J.K. Simmons is terrifyingly good.
Pure adrenaline. Keanu Reeves brings a quiet intensity that makes every action scene hit harder.
A horror masterpiece that uses genre conventions to deliver powerful social commentary.
An absolute masterpiece of modern sci-fi storytelling that never gets old.
RRR is pure cinematic euphoria! Rajamouli proves once again why Indian cinema is unmatched in scale and raw emotion.
The interval scene alone is worth watching ten times. Ram Charan and NTR gave career-best performances.
Why Kattappa killed Baahubali was answered with royal grandeur. Prabhas is an absolute king on screen.
Nag Ashwin has created a genuine sci-fi epic rooted in Mahabharata lore. Amitabh Bachchan as Ashwatthama is goosebumps!
Allu Arjun's swag in Pushpa is legendary. Sukumar's detailing of the Seshachalam forest world is top notch.
Rangasthalam is an emotional triumph. Ram Charan's acting as Chitti Babu is unforgettable.
Jersey brings tears every single time. Nani makes Arjun's struggle and unconditional fatherly love feel so real.
The poetic love story of Ram and Sita. Vishal Chandrashekhar's music and Kashmir visuals are breathtaking.
Hanu-Man took everyone by surprise with its VFX, heart, and goosebumps-inducing climax.
Mayabazar is the greatest film in the history of Telugu cinema. Every song and dialogue is immortal.
Vikram is a non-stop adrenaline rush. Kamal Haasan + Lokesh Kanagaraj = perfection.
12th Fail restored my faith in cinema. Re-start! Vikrant Massey deserves every award possible.
Manjummel Boys is the gold standard for survival thrillers in Indian cinema. The emotional payoff is unreal.
Kantara connects deeply with our folklore and roots. The climax performance by Rishab Shetty is divine.
